title: The Paris-Champagne Experience
subtitle: A week of movement, culture, and celebration

hero_image.alt: Haussmann facades and Paris rooftops rising above the roof of a vintage carousel, France

intro: There’s a certain rhythm to France. Mornings that begin slowly. Afternoons shaped by movement, conversation, and curiosity. Evenings that stretch—over wine, over meals, over moments you don’t rush.
about_body: In Paris, you’re based on the Left Bank—where mornings begin just outside your door with cafés, bookstores, and the quiet rhythm of Saint-Germain. The hotel itself carries that same understated elegance: classic architecture, thoughtful interiors, and the kind of atmosphere that makes it feel like you’ve stepped into the city rather than just arrived in it.

From here, the days unfold naturally—morning practice, long brunches, then out into the neighborhood or beyond. Evenings bring a different layer of Paris to life, from a walking food experience—tasting your way through its history and flavors—to a hands-on look at French cuisine that deepens your appreciation for what’s on the plate.
There’s also a curated fashion walk through the city’s most stylish corners, offering a more intimate look at the details that define Parisian style.

Then, in Champagne, everything softens. You settle into a modern, design-forward retreat surrounded by vineyards and forest—floor-to-ceiling windows, open views, and a sense of quiet that immediately shifts your pace.

Days here are shaped by contrast: movement in the morning, followed by spa time—sauna, steam, and space to unwind—then out into the region for curated tastings that feel personal and unhurried. This is Champagne experienced with intention, from vineyard walks to small producer visits, each one selected to feel less like a stop and more like an invitation.

accommodations.label: Boutique hotel in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Paris
text: A cozy Parisian cocoon, where each room whispers the history of Saint-Germain-des-Prés. Located on the Paris left bank, behind an elegant Haussmann façade, lies an address full of charm and nobility, the preferred pied-à-terre of discerning traveler.
Our charming boutique hotel welcomes you to the epicenter of Parisian culture where artists and intellectuals have always rubbed shoulders.

Each of the rooms has a chic, hushed atmosphere. Publisher’s textiles, quality woods, thick carpeting on the floor. Remembering that Paris hotel rooms are cozy, this charming boutique hotel has paid attention to every detail. Comfortable bedding, beautiful decor and perfectly located. Your place to land while we are in Paris.

faqs.question: Do you accept bitcoin?
answer: In addition to credit card payments we also accept wire transfers, Zelle and Bitcoin. Please inquire for more details.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
answer: All payments are 100% non refundable and non-transferable. We recommend that you buy Trip cancellation insurance immediately upon making your initial deposit to cover any travel hiccups or complications that may arise between now and the time of your retreat. No exceptions are possible so please cover your trip by connecting with an insurance company that offers the right policy for you.

faqs.question: What happens if my travel plans change?
answer: There are no refunds as per our cancellation policies. We highly recommend that all of our guests secure a quality travel insurance that will cover them for any event which may cause a change of travel plans, including personal health issues or personal situations in general which may affect travel plans.

faqs.question: Are flight delays or cancellations covered?
answer: Not by us: transportation delays, cancellations or changes due to strikes, labor disputes, or lockouts from airlines, boats, ferries or any type of transportation are among the events we recommend covering with travel insurance.
